observations.statement: Coordinate permutations and coordinate complementations are degree-preserving Boolean-cube automorphisms; they should be separated from XOR substitution and existential projection in every theta-rank argument.
Existential projection is the central unresolved escape from theta-rank lower bounds with auxiliary variables; ordinary coordinate isomorphism arguments do not control it.
H074 lacked a finite canonical observable interface and is therefore rejected rather than counted as a surviving bounded-theta lower-bound hypothesis.
Low degree or small SDP dimension does not by itself imply polynomial-time exact verification because coefficient bit complexity and conditioning can be exponential.
A fixed finite local grammar can simulate general computation over many sequential rounds; locality must be paired with dependency-depth or round accounting.
C009 expands the inversion matrix from 20x20 to 30x30 while keeping exactly seventy percent of selected hypotheses inherited from earlier cycles.

The strongest immediate theta program is now a three-way fork: prove bounded-depth extension stability, construct an explicit local projection collapse, or build canonical bounded-level SAT/UNSAT twins.
